dz: 鲁昂暴动(英语:Rouen Riot)是英国国王威廉·鲁弗斯企图夺取他弟弟诺曼底公爵罗伯特的都城鲁昂而失败.
de: The Rouen Riot, an attempt by English king William Rufus to take possession of Rouen, the capital city of his brother Robert, duke of Normandy, fails.
